label: bun is dropped from the sandbox image, so every source-lane build dies in-sandbox with a command-not-found buried in a build log
the bun PATH symlink is dropped, so bun is installed but invisible to execute_command (which runs no login shell)
the image-build-time bun verification is dropped, so a broken install becomes one failed build per site instead of one failed image build
node is substituted away by bun, breaking the generated project's `node scripts/prune-client.mjs` build step and the vendored paw-sites CLI
a blank DAYTONA_SANDBOX_IMAGE is treated as a real image reference instead of meaning 'use the prebuilt one'
